subject: Pilot MAP & gating checkpoints — sequencing MSA / DPA / Order Form
messages:
From: Acuity Diagnostics Procurement <procurement@acuitydx.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP request & sequencing for pilot engagement (MSA/DPA/order form)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is aligned on moving forward with a short pilot focused on EMR extraction and inference. Procurement asked me to reach out to start a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align gating checkpoints and estimated close dates.

High-level asks from Acuity:
- A draft MAP with responsibilities (legal, procurement, engineering)
- Expected sequencing for MSA / DPA / order form and typical review lead times
- Any required security artifacts (SOC2, encryption/KMS details, data flow diagrams)

Can you share a MAP template and a simple timeline (2–4 week cadence) that shows when we can expect legal and procurement milestones? We are targeting a pilot kickoff in mid-June but need to understand dependencies to confirm.

Attachment: Acuity_MSP_RFP_v1.pdf (pdf, 1 page)

Best,
Sam Park
Procurement Manager
Acuity Diagnostics
procurement@acuitydx.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP request & sequencing for pilot engagement (MSA/DPA/order form)

Hi Sam — great to hear the team wants to move forward. Attaching a MAP draft and a compact sequencing timeline for the pilot. High-level plan below; see attached spreadsheet for owner-level rows.

Proposed compact sequencing (targeted):
- Week 0 (today): Share MAP draft + initial scope (Redwood / Acuity) — owners: Prod & Procurement
- Week 1: Legal kickoff; Acuity to provide any required policy templates / vendor terms; Redwood provides SOC2 and security packet — owners: Legal teams
- Week 2: Redlines exchange (MSA); finalize DPA language in parallel if acceptable
- Week 3: Order form finalization and signatures (DocuSign) -> provisioning window triggered
- Week 4: Pilot provisioning + smoke tests

Key dependencies and gating checkpoints:
- If Acuity requires contract-level data residency or an on-prem installer, that will add 3–6 weeks.
- DPA redlines that require new encryption SLA or KMS integration will need technical signoff from our infra team (we can parallelize but estimate +1 week).

Suggested next steps:
1) I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff (legal + procurement + engineering) to walk the MAP and confirm owner names.
2) Rishi, can your team confirm which artifacts you want up front (SOC2, pen test, architecture diagram)?
3) Sam, if Acuity can share the Procurement checklist, we’ll align timeline items to that.

Attachment: redwood_map_draft_20270502.xlsx (xlsx, MAP & milestone grid)

Thanks — availability for a kickoff: Tue May 4 between 10–12 PT or Wed May 5 9–11 PT.

– Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com | tessa.morgan@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP request & sequencing for pilot engagement (MSA/DPA/order form)

Hi Sam — copying our legal and compliance notes below so you have visibility before the kickoff.

Quick clarifications from Redwood Legal / Security (summary):
- Required artifacts: SOC2 Type II report (latest 12 months), Data Flow Diagram (we can produce), Pen test summary. We’ll include these in the MAP under "Security Artifacts" with expected delivery by May 7.
- DPA: We can accept most standard redlines but need to confirm any requests around vendor-managed KMS vs. customer-managed KMS. If Acuity insists on customer-managed HSM/bring-your-own-key, we will need a short technical review and (~1 week) infra changes.
- SLA / uptime: Standard commercial SLA is 99.9% for hosted; extended SLAs require an entitlements discussion (cost impact).

Suggested sequencing adjustments (internal recommendation):
- Move legal redline window earlier (Week 1) and allow a 3–5 business day review for DPA parallel to MSA.
- Reserve a 5 business day buffer for procurement redlines and DocuSign routing.

If the Acuity procurement team can confirm whether they require a KMS BYOK flow or if vendor-managed keys are acceptable, we’ll tighten the timeline to meet your mid-June pilot target.

On Tue May 4 I can join the kickoff at 10:30 PT — please confirm.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Legal & Compliance, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Elena Roman (General Counsel) <elena.roman@acuitydx.com>

Cc: Sam Park <procurement@acuitydx.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP request & sequencing for pilot engagement (MSA/DPA/order form)

Thanks — attaching an initial redline for the DPA and a short note about KMS. A few items to highlight:

- We prefer the DPA to be integrated into Exhibit A of the MSA rather than a standalone annex (faster for our internal review).
- Acuity’s security policy requires customer-controlled keys for production data; for the pilot, we can accept vendor-managed keys but will require a migration path to BYOK prior to GA.
- Please confirm the retention windows for logs and audit artifacts; Acuity requires 24 months for audit logs.

Attachment: redlines_may04.docx (docx, DPA redlines)

If the MAP shows the DPA finalized in Week 2, we will expedite our internal redline turn (we typically aim for 3 business days for pilot agreements).

Best,
Elena Roman
